releaseNotes:
• 3 New Akura Pro Themes: Midnight (Pro Dark), Snow (Pro Light), Emerald (Pro Green) with dynamic luminance & contrast
• Universal Density Scaling: Auto-scales padding, fonts and keys cleanly across all screen densities
• Touch Ripple Feedback: Physical key press animation using theme keyPressedColor
• Singlish Engine v2: Fixed diphthongs (kai/kau), W as consonant (dewwa/swaamiyaa), uppercase & C key mappings
• Synchronized Key Hints: What keys show is exactly what they type
• Smart Prediction Engine: Helakuru-style fuzzy skeleton matching + privacy protection (no password/OTP logging)
• Action-Aware Enter Key: Triggers Send, Search, Go, Next & Done properly
• In-Keyboard Translator v2: Language auto-detection, multi-engine fallback & text replacement
• WhatsApp Status Saver: 100% universal SAF folder detection & 1-tap gallery saving
